title: Only 3% Can Pass This Italian Cuisine Quiz
summary: Explore The Classic Table, Ingredients and Regions, Traditions and Flavours, Pasta and Preparation, The Final Menu across five six-question rounds.

landing.intro:
Know your way around the menu?
Take a taste of Italy.

about.body:
Five rounds offer different angles on this challenge: The Classic Table, Ingredients and Regions, Traditions and Flavours, Pasta and Preparation, The Final Menu. Each round contains six distinct questions.

Choose one of four answers and move on automatically. There is no time limit. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, each next round and the final result. The target is 24 correct answers out of 30. The result describes this quiz attempt only.

For entertainment and general learning only. Regional recipes and family traditions can vary, and this quiz does not determine professional culinary expertise.

steps: Press Start, watch a short rewarded ad and begin.
Choose one answer per question and progress through five rounds.
Complete all 30 questions to reveal your result. You can then unlock the full breakdown.
